crossRefs.note: They said to him, “Behold, you are old, and your sons don’t walk in your ways. Now make us a king to judge us like all…
For how would people know that I have found favor in your sight, I and your people? Isn’t it that you go with us, so…
But I have said to you, “You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess it, a land flowing with…
For from the top of the rocks I see him. From the hills I see him. Behold, it is a people that dwells alone, and shall…
For you are a holy people to Yahweh your God. Yahweh your God has chosen you to be a people for his own possession…
but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.
If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of…
rejoicing in hope; enduring in troubles; continuing steadfastly in prayer;
Therefore “ ‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.
For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,
But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim…
